number_of_biological_replicates: For proteomic and transcriptomic profiling, BM-MSC of three (40y, 39y, 27y) and four different donors (40y, 39y, 27y, 20y) were included, respectively.
number_of_fractions: Peptides (180 μg) were separated by in-solution isoelectric focusing (OFFGEL fractionator, Agilent) into 12 fractions over a pH range of 3–10.
technology_type: Here we performed an in depth characterization of human ESC-MSC, comparing them to human bone marrow-derived MSC (BM-MSC) as well as human embryonic stem cells (hESC) by transcriptomics (RNA-seq) and quantitative proteomics (nanoLC-MS/MS using SILAC).
